turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail: UK, our Standard Delivery arrives in 2 to 3 working days. It costs £3.95, or is free when you spend over £49. If you need it sooner: - Express Delivery: next working day when you order Monday to Friday by 7pm (£7.95). - Click & Collect: ready the next working day when you order by 7pm Sunday to Friday (£3.50). Orders placed on Saturday are ready on Monday. If you are shipping outside the UK, delivery times vary by destination. Let me know the country and I will advise the best available option.
